Required: `dealKind` (PURCHASE | REFINANCE), `propertyType` (HDB | PRIVATE | COMM

tools.name: compare_packages

tools.name: list_banks
tools.description: List active banks and lenders (id and name), sorted by name. Use it to resolve a borrower's current lender to the `currentBankId` that `recommend_packages` requires for refinance deals. Not a rate source.

tools.name: get_property_valuation
tools.description: Indicative valuation (SGD) for a Singapore residential unit from an external valuation source. tools.name: calculate_package_schedule
tools.description:
Compute the amortisation schedule for a specific mortgage package using that package's real effective rates. Returns loan facts (`context`), the per-tier breakdown (`periods`), rate structure, totals and the per-year schedule (`annual`).

Required: `packageId` from `recommend_packages`, `loanAmount`

tools.name: list_market_indices
tools.description: List market benchmark indices (id, slug, name, currency), sorted by slug. Use this to resolve a benchmark name like 'SORA' into the `marketIndexId` required by `get_index_quotes`.

tools.name: get_index_quotes
tools.description: Return historical quotes (rate by date) for a market benchmark index such as SORA. Requires `marketIndexId` from `list_market_indices`. Optional `startDate`/`endDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) narrow the range; results are paginated, newest first. Quote `rate` values are decimal fractions (0.0356 = 3.56% p.a.).

tools.name: calculate_affordability
tools.description: Estimate the maximum loan and property price (SGD) a borrower can afford from monthly income, existing debt commitments and tenure, applying Singapore TDSR/MSR limits. tools.name: calculate_required_income
tools.description: Reverse affordability: work out the gross monthly income (SGD) needed to support a target property price under Singapore TDSR/MSR limits. Use this when you know the target price; for the budget a known income supports, use `calculate_affordability`.

tools.name: calculate_mortgage_repayment
tools.description: Compute the monthly repayment, total interest and total cost (SGD) for a hypothetical loan from a loan amount, tenure and an interest rate you supply (standard amortisation). Use this for what-if rates; for the real rates of a specific package, use `calculate_package_schedule` instead.

tools.name: calculate_refinance_savings

tools.name: calculate_mortgage_stamp_duty

tools.name: calculate_seller_stamp_duty
tools.description: Compute Singapore Seller's Stamp Duty (SSD, in SGD) from the sale price or value and how long the residential property has been held. For net cash from a sale, use `calculate_sales_proceeds`.
